summary: Friday's session stayed rate-driven: 10-year real yields held near cycle highs and the 10Y-2Y curve kept its steepening bias, pressuring gold and long-duration Treasuries. Equity breadth stayed thin as defensive shares lagged growth, while bitcoin held most of its 30-day rally despite cooling volume and momentum.
tweet: Elevated real yields and a steepening curve kept gold and bonds under pressure Friday, even as crypto held its 30-day rally and equity breadth stayed thin.
